role: background-worker-owned event-triggered chain launch and stalled run recovery
owns: background-worker lifecycle for typed chain-watcher start, status, and stop
background-worker startup and periodic typed watchdog scans with durable status reporting
event-triggered chain launch with handled-marker idempotency
stalled run recovery and scoped terminal-session reaping

watchdog.lifecycle: run once at worker startup, then on the worker 60-second interval with an in-flight guard; result and transport failures are written to background-worker status
watchdog.loop: observe scoped PTY state, scan runs, recheck liveness before mutation, recover incomplete durable stall effects, and reap only dead sessions proven to belong to terminal scoped runs after a fresh liveness read

chain_event_watcher.singleton: one in-process service plus a per-namespace/org mkdir lock with live-pid detection and stale-lock reclaim; duplicate watchers must not accumulate
chain_event_watcher.loop: filesystem watch with a bounded timeout fallback, then strict event parsing and chain config.event_triggers scanning; an unexpected service failure exits the worker non-zero for process-manager restart
chain_event_watcher.interval: DEFAULT_POLL_INTERVAL_MS = 10000 when the filesystem watch does not fire

event_triggers.condition_policy: evaluateChainWatcherCondition implements a narrow comparison grammar; command substitution, backticks, ; | &, [[ ]] breakout, process substitution, unsafe regex forms, and newlines do not match; empty condition always matches
event_triggers.launch: detached bin/mentiko run <chain_path> child process from TypeScript

watchdog_recovery.stall_condition: running run has no alive session/monitor/grace and running or pending agents
watchdog_recovery.write: updateRunJson read-modify-write under the shared run lock with a durable runnerV2.watchdog step marker
watchdog_recovery.event: strictly serialized diagnostic run-stalled event with recovery details in data; not a canonical agent handoff
watchdog_recovery.effects: task-status and notification enqueue is deduped by stable effect IDs; executable hooks are at-least-once with a stable dispatch key exposed to hooks and a durable zero-exit acknowledgement; incomplete post-terminalization steps are retried on later scans

session_liveness.reap_scope: deny-list of terminal run states: only runs in completed/failed/stopped territory are reap-eligible; unknown or non-terminal statuses (pending, blocked, paused, future values) are spared (e289ea8)
session_liveness.foreign_scope: the worker resolves one configured project and its namespaced PTY transport; explicit alternate paths are required for another scope
session_liveness.reap_policy: remove only dead agent and companion-monitor names referenced exclusively by terminal scoped runs after a fresh PTY list recheck; never remove a currently alive or unreferenced session

invariants: do not treat stale age as dead if PTY session is live
do not kill live monitor sessions
watchdog diagnostic events do not use canonical agent handoff shape
watcher idempotency uses handled markers, not processed mutation
run-session reaping is deny-list based: unknown or non-terminal run status is never reaped (e289ea8)
spawned shells inherit sanitized env: BASH_FUNC_* stripped at the spawn layer (7816b0f)
